name: Video Slider for YouTube (Lite)
author: ftsoftware

sections.description:
YouTube Slider Lite lets you create unlimited slider sets:
– Normal (16:9) or Shorts (9:16)
– Custom arrow and dot colors per slider
– Simple shortcode: [youtube_slider id="123"]
– Lightweight (Swiper) and responsive

Works with Gutenberg, Elementor and others.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to YouTube Sliders → Add New, paste one YouTube URL per line, pick the type & colors, Publish.
  4. Insert [youtube_slider id="YOUR_ID"] into any page/post.
sections.faq:
How do I use Shorts?

Choose Shorts (9:16) in the slider settings, or override: [youtube_slider id="123" type="shorts"].

Can I use multiple sliders on the same page?

Yes, insert as many shortcodes as you like, each with a different id.

Does it load assets only when needed?

Yes, CSS/JS are enqueued only when the shortcode is rendered.
